note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); the requirement is given. The review screen (Update Decision and Summary tabs) shows data from the submission and can download the documentary proof. Gaps: offence details are only notice no, vehicle no, place and offence date/time (no offence type, rule code, amount); the current processing stage is a snapshot at submission; the registered owner/hirer/driver details of the notice are not shown for comparison. Two steps (stage, owner/hirer particulars) deliberately use the same fit as OCMS41.11 and OCMS41.13 because the fact is the same. Blob contents and user roles cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Claim partially: submission date and documentary proof download are proven. Full offence details, the live stage and the registered owner/hirer/driver data are not on the review screen

steps.detail: The 'Notice Details' section only holds Notice No, Vehicle No, Place of Offence (pp code) and Notice Date and Time (DecisionForm.tsx:132-159; DecissionDetails.tsx:119-138). Offence type, rule code, amount payable and other offence fields of the notice are not shown because the 'Offence Info' group is hidden in UPDATE mode (Form.tsx:116). Place of Offence shows the code (DecissionDetails.tsx:104-108 uses pp_code), not the name.

The 'Current Processing Stage' field exists in DecisionForm.tsx:169-173 and DecissionDetails.tsx:149-152, but it holds lastProcessingStage of the submission. The lastProcessingStage column of ocms_furnish_application is only copied from eocms_furnish_application during the sync (ocmsadminprivateapi/.../furnish_processing/helpers/FurnishSyncHelper.java:189). I found no code that updates this column after the notice moves to another stage; approval only changes the VON (ManualReviewService.java:904). So what is shown is the stage at submission, not the current stage. Same fit as step 3 of OCMS41.11.

steps.step: Layar menampilkan tanggal dan jam submission
steps.detail: The 'Submission Date and Time' field (creDate, with time) is shown read-only in DecisionForm.tsx:162-168 and DecissionDetails.tsx:143-148, together with Status, Reason for Review and Remarks (DecisionForm.tsx:174-199). The creDate value is copied from the Internet record during sync; its content cannot be verified from the repo.

Shown: Submitter's Particulars (DecisionForm.tsx:201-244) and Furnished Hirer/Driver's Particulars (DecisionForm.tsx:255-360). Not shown: the owner/hirer/driver already recorded on the notice, because the Owner/Hirer/Driver Details tab is only rendered in EDIT/SPECIAL mode (Form.tsx:166-182) and Preview in UPDATE mode only calls DecisionDetails (Preview.tsx:57-88). The officer cannot compare with the current offender on the same screen. Same fit as step 2 of OCMS41.13.

steps.step: Officer dapat mengunduh documentary proof yang disubmit
steps.detail: The Update Decision form holds 'Supporting Documents' per docType with per-file download/preview and a 'Download All' button (DecisionForm.tsx:386-410) using useFurnishAttachment (useFurnishAttachment.ts:97-130) against POST furnish-downloads (OcmsFurnishApplicationDocController.java:85-130; OCMS_OIC_FURNISH mapping, api-authorization.properties:83). Same fact as step 5 of OCMS41.13, so the same fit. Blob content cannot be verified from the repo.
